proof_body:
by
  intro T _ f a n _
  simp only [fourierCoeff, smul_eq_mul]
  rw [← MeasureTheory.integral_add_right_eq_self (fun t => fourier (-n) t * f t) a, ← MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul]
  congr 1
  funext t
  have : fourier (-n) t = fourier n a * fourier (-n) (t + a) := by
    rw [fourier_apply, fourier_apply, fourier_apply, ← Circle.coe_mul, ← AddCircle.toCircle_add]
    congr 2
    rw [smul_add, neg_smul, neg_smul]
    abel
  rw [this]
  ring
target_source: ∀ (T : ℝ) [hT : Fact (0 < T)] (f : AddCircle T → ℂ) (a : AddCircle T) (n : ℤ), MeasureTheory.Integrable f AddCircle.haarAddCircle → fourierCoeff (fun x => f (x + a)) n = fourier n a * fourierCoeff f n
